description: Finite audit of local git operations against the binding formulation 'commit amend and comparable history rewriting'. Every operation lands in exactly one category. Ambiguous operations are reported as open findings; no new owner rule is invented for them.

operations.rationale: Replaces the tip commit object. The mandatory case of this block.
Rewrites a range of commits. Already in the B0a-1 deny set.
Rebase behind a different subcommand; the same rewrite.
Moves the branch and discards the worktree state. Already in the B0a-1 deny set.
Rewrites every commit of a range. Unambiguously the same class as amend.
External equivalent of filter-branch.
Moves a branch to an arbitrary commit; equivalent in effect to reset for that ref.
Moves an existing branch to another commit; the same ref rewrite.
Substitutes objects and therefore rewrites apparent history. The read only --list form stays permitted.
Destroys the recovery path that makes a rewrite reconstructible. The B0a-3 amend chain was only provable because the reflog existed.
Equivalent to stash drop for every entry; stash drop was already denied.
Owner action, not a rewrite. Listed for completeness; already in the B0a-1 deny set and it also covers every forced push variant.
Creates new commits, it does not rewrite existing ones. Forbidden for this block by scope, but a permanent guard rule would need an owner decision.
Produces a new commit from a range without touching the range. Not a rewrite of existing history.
Plumbing that can build arbitrary history but moves no reference on its own.
Moves the branch without discarding the worktree. Whether the non --hard forms count as a rewrite is a genuine owner question.
Deleting a merged temporary branch is routine work; deleting an unmerged one loses reachability. Ambiguous.
Moves a tag. A tag is not history, but it is a published marker.
Routine maintenance that can nevertheless remove unreachable objects of an earlier rewrite.
Starts a parentless line. It rewrites nothing that exists.
Annotates commits without changing them.
